import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 300;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        int rev;
        int flow;
        int cap;

        Edge(int d, int r, int f, int c) {
            dest = d;
            rev = r;
            flow = f;
            cap = c;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] g = new List[MAX_N];
    static int[] lvl = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAX_N];
    static int s, t;

    static void link(int u, int v, int c, int rc) {
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, g[v].size(), 0, c));
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, g[u].size() - 1, 0, rc));
    }

    static boolean levelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        lvl[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty() && lvl[t] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                int v = e.dest;
                if (lvl[v] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    lvl[v] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return lvl[t] != -1;
    }

    static int augment(int u, int f) {
        if (u == t || f == 0) return f;
        for (int i = cur[u]; i < g[u].size(); ++i) {
            cur[u] = i;
            Edge e = g[u].get(i);
            int v = e.dest;
            if (lvl[v] != lvl[u] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = augment(v, Math.min(f, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                g[v].get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int total = 0;
        while (levelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = augment(s, INF)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int N, M;
    static int[][] wall, limit, dist;
    static String[] grid1, grid2;

    static void bfs(int r, int c, int[][] d, boolean useLimit) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(d[i], -1);
        d[r][c] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{r, c});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            if (useLimit && d[x][y] == limit[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dr[k], ny = y + dc[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || d[nx][ny] != -1 || wall[nx][ny] == 1) continue;
                if (useLimit && limit[nx][ny] > -1 && d[x][y] + 1 > limit[nx][ny]) continue;
                d[nx][ny] = d[x][y] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        grid1 = new String[N];
        grid2 = new String[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) grid1[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) grid2[i] = br.readLine();

        wall = new int[N][N];
        limit = new int[N][N];
        dist = new int[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                wall[i][j] = (grid1[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') ? 1 : 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                if (grid1[i].charAt(j) == 'Z')
                    bfs(i, j, limit, false);

        s = 2 * N * N + 5;
        t = s + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i)
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                if (grid1[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || grid1[x].charAt(y) == 'Y') continue;
                link(s, N * x + y, grid1[x].charAt(y) - '0', 0);
                link(N * N + N * x + y, t, grid2[x].charAt(y) - '0', 0);
                bfs(x, y, dist, true);
                for (int xp = 0; xp < N; ++xp) {
                    for (int yp = 0; yp < N; ++yp) {
                        if (dist[xp][yp] != -1 && dist[xp][yp] <= M) {
                            link(N * x + y, N * N + N * xp + yp, INF, 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
